explanation: This theorem is the descent step from Atkin–Lehner newform theory. Suppose a cusp form f of level N with character χ has vanishing q-coefficients at every index coprime to p·L. Then there is a cusp form F of level N/p with character χ₀ whose m-th coefficient equals the (p·m)-th coefficient of f for every m coprime to L. It depends on the library's own definitions (`cuspFormCharSpace`, `descendCuspForm`, `descendMatrixCount`) and on its own auxiliary lemmas. I grepped Mathlib's NumberTheory/ModularForms directory for `cuspFormCharSpace`, `Newform` and `newform` and found no matches. Mathlib has no theory of character spaces of cusp forms, newforms or level-lowering descent, so nothing there could state this result.
